meta.title: RealtyBoss for Real Estate Brokerages — operate your brokerage, not just track agents
meta.description: The brokerage operating system that makes every agent your top producer. Broker-first dashboard, agent-fitness flags, AI nurture, and per-agent pricing that undercuts kvCORE by 40-60%.

hero.h1_tail: for running your brokerage — not another CRM your agents have to learn.
hero.body: Brokerages compete on two numbers: average GCI per agent and 12-month retention. Both stall when your tech treats the broker as a passive bystander. We built this with the brokerage owner as the primary user.
hero.reassurance: No deck. No pressure. We rebuild the ROI model on your actual numbers.

problem.h2: You already bought the CRM. Your agents just don't use it.
problem.body1: Most brokerages spend six figures a year on a CRM — and most of the seats sit empty. It isn't a training problem. A CRM gives already-overwhelmed agents more to do: more logging, more reminders, more tabs. So it goes unused, and the spend returns almost nothing.
problem.body2: RealtyBoss flips that. It's not another tool to log into — it's an AI team that does the work: answers the calls, follows up with every lead, coordinates the deals, and keeps it compliant. Adoption isn't a battle when there's nothing to learn.
problem.stat_label: the real cost of a CRM your agents never open

retention.label: 12-month retention
retention.hint: Top agents stay for the tools

how.subtitle: One platform for the entire lead-to-listing cycle. Plus the recruiting layer that keeps your roster growing.

capture.title: Capture
capture.body: Every agent gets a personal home-value funnel + the lead programs you're already paying for (Zillow, Realtor.com) plug in.

nurture.title: Nurture
nurture.body: AI SMS/email replies within 5 minutes, in the agent's voice, with TCPA-compliant disclosures. 80% of follow-up the agent was skipping, handled.

convert.title: Convert
convert.body: Calendar booking + auto-reminders. CMAs generated in 60 sec so the agent shows up to the appointment ready to present.

retain.title: Retain + grow
retain.body: Broker sees fitness flags before agents quit. Recruiting pipeline + onboarding checklist for the producers you're trying to poach.

broker_features.subtitle: Most real estate CRMs treat the broker as someone who reads reports. We treat the broker as the primary user. The home screen is yours.

command_center.title: Brokerage-wide command center
command_center.body: Every agent's pipeline in one view. Total pipeline, this-month closes, speed-to-lead median, retention rate — at a glance.

leaderboard.title: Real-time agent leaderboard
leaderboard.body: Speed-to-lead, response rate, appts-set, closes — by agent, ranked. Visible to all agents. Top producers compete; underperformers can't hide.

fitness_flags.title: Agent-fitness flags
fitness_flags.body: Automatic alerts when response time slips, a hot lead goes cold for 24h+, or an agent's pipeline shrinks week-over-week. Catch retention risk before they leave.

distribution.title: Lead-distribution rules you control
distribution.body: Round-robin, geo, top-producer-priority, or opt-in. Set policy once; system enforces. Agents can't cherry-pick or sandbag.

recruiting.title: Recruiting + onboarding pipeline
recruiting.body: Track every recruit from coffee meeting → license filed → onboarded → first sale. New-agent checklist (license verified, MLS linked, templates approved) keeps your managing broker on top of it.

compliance.title: Compliance posture, brokerage-wide
compliance.body: TCPA opt-in audit per lead. Supervised review queue for AI-drafted outbound. Searchable archive of every message. When an FCC complaint lands, evidence in 30 seconds.

agent_features.eyebrow: What every agent gets — the mechanism
agent_features.h2: Tools your agents actually want to use
agent_features.subtitle: Adoption follows utility, not policy. The home-value funnel and CMA generator are the wedge — agents pick them up because they want to look professional, not because the broker told them to.

nurture.title: AI nurture in under 5 minutes
nurture.body: Every inbound lead gets an SMS or email reply in the agent's voice, with TCPA-compliant disclosures auto-appended.

cma.title: AI CMA in 60 seconds
cma.body: Agent enters an address, gets an agent-branded comparative market analysis ready to send to a homeowner. The agent-adoption wedge.

funnel.title: Agent-branded home-value funnel
funnel.body: Every agent gets a personal URL — they share on social, postcards, email signature. Leads land directly in their pipeline, attributed to them, visible to the broker.

calendar.title: Calendar booking + sit reminders
calendar.body: Prospects book directly into the agent's calendar. T-24h and T-2h reminders fire automatically. Show-rate climbs.

comparison.h2: What brokerages use today vs. what actually moves the metrics
comparison.subtitle: Honest read on the category. Every other tool was built for someone other than the brokerage owner.

kvcore.limit: Built agent-first; broker dashboard is a reporting afterthought. AI is template substitution. $4,500–6,000/mo for 100 agents.

fub.limit: Cleanest agent UX. Zero broker tools. Broker analytics costs $300/agent in 'FUB Custom'. $6,900/mo for 100 agents.

chime.limit: Closest to us on intent. 5-year-old UX. AI is template-based, not LLM-generative.

boomtown.limit: Excellent CS team. $1,500–3,500+/mo before agent seats. Pricing makes sense for $5M+ brokerages, not 100-agent independents.

spreadsheets.limit: Fast for small teams. Zero broker visibility. WhatsApp isn't TCPA-compliant for prospecting.

realtyboss.limit: ✓ Broker-first home screen, real LLM AI, agent-fitness flags, $24/agent at 100 — half the category cost.

pricing.subtitle: All tiers include the full platform — broker dashboard, agent CRM, AI nurture, CMA generator, home-value funnel, compliance archive. Pricing locks for year one with a 10% cap on any renewal increase.
pricing.footnote: A 100-agent brokerage at $24/agent is $2,880/mo — roughly half the cost of kvCORE or Follow Up Boss at the same scale. Existing CRM you replace usually covers the line item.

vs_kvcore.q: How is this different from kvCORE or Follow Up Boss?
vs_kvcore.a: kvCORE was built agent-first, with broker reporting bolted on. FUB has the cleanest agent UX in the category and explicitly doesn't try to serve brokerages — broker analytics costs $300/agent on top in their Custom tier. We built the broker dashboard as the home screen and shipped real AI (not template substitution) at $24/agent at 100 — roughly half the cost.

adoption.q: Will my agents actually adopt it?
adoption.a: Adoption is the real game. Two structural answers: the AI does 80% of the follow-up the agent was never going to do anyway, so the friction is closer to 'check email' than 'learn Salesforce.' And the home-value funnel + CMA generator are tools agents will use because they want to look professional — adoption follows utility, not policy.

migration.q: What about migration from our current CRM?
migration.a: Standard CSV import for contacts, leads, pipeline stages. Workflow mapping during onboarding. Plan for 4–6 weeks of parallel-running both systems, then deprecate the old one. We've done this.

scale.q: Has any brokerage with 100+ agents used this?
scale.a: Honestly, you'd be among our first three large-brokerage deployments. 3,400+ producers run on the platform today, but most are individual agents or small teams. The tradeoff: in exchange for being a first-mover, you get the product shaped around your workflow, direct founder access during deployment, and a case study at month 12 that becomes your moat against the brokerages who come after.

pricing_catch.q: What's the catch on the pricing?
pricing_catch.a: No catch. We're newer at the brokerage tier and pricing accordingly to win deployments. Pricing locks for year one with a 10% cap on any renewal increase. We can afford this because we don't have a sales-led GTM yet.

final_cta.body: You, your managing broker, and one or two of your top producers. We walk through the broker dashboard with your numbers — actual or sample at your scale. Producers stress-test the workflows. We close with concrete ROI math against your lead spend and agent count.
final_cta.reassurance: No deck. No slideware. No pressure.
